tasks.title: The First Pages
tasks.description: Every oath begins with a journey. Explore Upper Guk, Unrest and Runnyeye. Find their entrances, learn the way home, and prepare escape and recovery tools before going deeper. Your Tasks window records each visit. Return to the Ancient Chronicler in the East Commonlands tunnel for the next chapter. Mera Vell is searching for the Company of the Last Lantern. Read each entrance courier's copy: the same name has been scratched from every page.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Beneath the Surface
tasks.description: Earn your first dungeon victories. Defeat the froglok warden in Upper Guk and the reclusive ghoul magus in Unrest. Plan around linked pulls, runners and spell interruption. Victory itself is the proof; you do not need a rare quest drop. Ordinary group and pet kill credit applies to your individual journal. After those victories, ask the Chronicler to enter a private journal expedition and rescue the missing porter. Return with his account.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Steel and Sorcery
tasks.description: Face Battlelord Paluk in Runnyeye and the goblin sage in Permafrost. Prepare for physical pressure and hostile magic, manage recovery between pulls, and learn when to retreat. After both victories, return to the Ancient Chronicler. At level 35, five archetype paths become available, regardless of your Primary class. Bring the expedition records to Mera in the Commonlands tunnel. She recognizes Captain Selene's seal.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Guardian: The Unbroken Oath
tasks.description: Learn to survive pressure without exhausting your recovery. Defeat the froglok shin lord in Upper Guk and Lord Pickclaw in Runnyeye, then face Xicotl in Mistmoore. Prepare a safe fighting position and reserve a defensive answer for the final pull. Completion unlocks the Guardian attunement. Return to the Chronicler to forge or attune your Epic 0.5 charm.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Striker: A Decisive Hand
tasks.description: Master controlled aggression in Mistmoore. Defeat Butler Syncall and Maid Issis before facing Garton Viswin. Choose where you fight, prevent runners from widening a pull, and keep enough endurance for the next engagement. Completion unlocks the Striker attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Arcanist: The Measured Flame
tasks.description: Win with deliberate use of magic and resources. Defeat Battlewizard Unak in Runnyeye and High Priest Zaharn in Permafrost, then face Lasna Cheroon in Mistmoore. Vary your damage types, consider control and interruption, and plan your mana recovery. Completion unlocks the Arcanist attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Warden: The Last Light
tasks.description: Balance recovery against the cost of staying in the fight. Defeat Khrix Fritchoff in Unrest and Maid Issis in Mistmoore, then return to Unrest to face Garanel Rucksif. Keep an emergency resource in reserve and avoid turning each pull into a battle of attrition. Completion unlocks the Warden attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: Binder: An Unbroken Bond
tasks.description: Practice precise pet control and keep yourself alive alongside your companions. Defeat King Thex'Ka IV in Permafrost and Mynthi Davissi in Mistmoore, then face Xicotl. Plan pet positioning, retreats and recovery; additional pets should never pull more than you can manage. Completion unlocks the Binder attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern equipment; return to the company.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal records the victory. Return to the Ancient Chronicler.

tasks.title: A Name Beneath the Moss
tasks.description: Mera followed the missing company into Lower Guk. Find her marked satchel, defend her retreat and bring her account home.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: What the Fire Kept
tasks.description: The recorder traded the company seal in the depths of Solusek's dungeons. Defeat his lieutenants and defend the furnace while Oren restores it.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: The Captain's Last Watch
tasks.description: Reconstruct Captain Selene's last retreat in Cazic-Thule. Read her records, hold the marked positions and bring her final decision home.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: The Debt of the Living
tasks.description: In The Hole, the Witness's agent holds the stolen roster. Recover it and escape with Mera. The Chronicler must finally read every missing name.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: Where Courage Ends
tasks.description: Carry the company's courage into Fear. Release three bound names, survive the pursuer and recover the standard. Move, interrupt and leave yourself an escape.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: The Weight of a Name
tasks.description: The Hollow Witness waits in Hate. Break through his chosen guard, stop him consuming the recorded names, and tell Mera what your oath now means.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: A Light Carried Forward
tasks.description: Gather the survivors in Commonlands. Return a personal effect, choose a memorial inscription and prepare to carry the restored standard into the final expedition.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.

tasks.title: The Last Lantern
tasks.description: In a final private Hate expedition, break the Witness's bindings, defend the company standard and face the man who traded his companions' names. Then return to the Commonlands campfire.
tasks.reward_text: Personal Last Lantern progression; claim and refit with Oren.
tasks.completion_emote: Your journal remembers. Return to the Commonlands company.
